method: The built-in browser pane at 375 x 812 (mobile emulation), the Next.js dev server on :3000 against the demonstration API on :8000, dark colour scheme, English, signed in as the demonstration organisations' own accounts (recruiter@apollo-care.example for Apollo Care Hospitals, an employer; admin@nsdc-healthcare-academy.example for NSDC Healthcare Academy, a training provider). BEFORE = measured on main at the start of the sprint (the provider's before taken with web/src and web/e2e stashed); AFTER = this branch. NOT the capture script and NOT the sweep (no Chromium on the machine). A control under 44 px is an a/button/select/input/textarea/[role] narrower or shorter than 43.5 px, a checkbox by its label; a sentence's inline link is exempt, as in the sweep and in WCAG 2.5.8.
layoutShift: A PerformanceObserver read in the pane reported 0 on both workspace homes after the workspaces became lazy chunks, but it only counts shifts inside the viewport and the pane is not the sweep's check: not a substitute for it.

firstLoadJsBytes.note: build:e2e then route-bundle-stats.json; main (after Sprint 87) and this branch built the same way

firstAttempt.note: with both workspaces still imported statically by OrgWorkspace the route was 3,701 bytes OVER the 700,000 ceiling; the CI web job's budget step would have failed

firstLoadJsBytes.explanation: OrgWorkspace imported both the employer's and the provider's workspace, so every organisation downloaded both. Each is a next/dynamic chunk now, with the memberships' own Skeleton as the placeholder.
